    StartersItalian Stallion tomato bruschettaGrilled ciabatta rubbed with garlic, topped with tomato, basil and balsamicHow to make it1 ciabatta loaf1 clove garlic500g ripe tomatoes1 small bunch basil3 tbsp extra virgin olive oil, plus extra for brushing1 tsp balsamic vinegar50g parmesan, shavedsea salt, to tasteSlice the ciabatta into 12 pieces and brush with olive oil.Grill until charred and rub each piece with the cut garlic.Dice the tomatoes and mix with torn basil, olive oil, balsamic and salt.Rest the tomato mix.Pile on the bread just before serving and top with shaved parmesan.Venice beach fish tacosBeer-battered fried flathead with cabbage and lime crema in corn tortillasHow to make it500g flathead fillets, cut in strips300g plain flour330ml cold lager1 L vegetable oil, for frying200ml sour cream2 limes12 small corn tortillas1/4 small cabbage, shredded4 tbsp fresh salsaWhisk the flour with cold lager to a light batter.Mix the sour cream with lime juice for a crema.Dip the flathead strips in the batter and fry in the vegetable oil at 180°C in batches until crisp.Warm the tortillas.Fill with cabbage, fish, crema and salsa.Chilli lime chicken street tacosThe old Los Angeles gym where Apollo started outHow to make itAs written, serves 4Chicken thighs marinated in chilli, lime and garlic, grilled until charred and chopped, on small corn tortillas with onion, coriander and a smoky salsa roja.Marinate 700g chicken thighs for 1 hour in the juice of 2 limes, 2 garlic cloves, 2 tsp chilli powder, 1 tsp cumin and oil.Grill over high heat for 5 minutes a side and chop.Char 3 tomatoes and a soaked dried chilli, then blitz with a garlic clove and salt for salsa.Warm 16 small corn tortillas and fill with chicken, diced white onion, coriander and salsa.Hot pastrami slidersPaulie smashed the pinball machine.
